turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Hi Marcus! Happy New Year. How is your Monday starting out over in Portland?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hey there! It's a bit cold and damp here in Portland today, but I'm doing well. I started the morning off right and made myself some eggs and toast for breakfast.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That sounds like a great, solid breakfast to kick off the week, especially with the nutritionist's advice in mind. Did you have a busy morning at the school after the holiday break?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: It was busy getting the science department organized for the new term, but I managed to find time for a workout and did some gym weights during my break.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Look at you go! How is your lower back feeling after working out with the gym weights? Still completely recovered and holding up well?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Yes, thankfully my back feels completely fine. No pain or stiffness at all while lifting, so I think I'm totally back to normal.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That is wonderful news. It must be a relief to lift without any issues. How is Grace doing today? Is she having a busy start to her week too?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: She is! Grace had a pretty packed schedule today, so we are both looking forward to just relaxing at home tonight.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: I don't blame you both at all. A quiet evening is the best way to recharge. Do you have any plans, or are you just going to take it easy?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: We are definitely taking it easy. We plan to sit down and start a new sci-fi series on that streaming service we got recently.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Oh, a sci-fi series sounds like a perfect escape for a chilly Monday evening. I hope it's a good one!

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Thanks! I'm sure Olive will end up curling up on the couch with us too once we turn the TV on.
